instruction: I'm finishing my work and need to email it to my boss, mike. But first, I need to get some information from a personal file. Could you provide me with the most consumed drinks and food categories for each age demographic? Also, I need my boss's email address. I remember recording my earnings of my business focused on animal well-being on the year tina turner died. Could you help me find the net earnings for the seven day period in that year including the day when domingo faustino sarmiento was born.

Provide me the total distance that the trip would take in meters, and give me the date of that battle and the date when the colombian war of independence started.

Then, for my research, pick the genre with the highest stock and fin an article about it published on the same day I'm planning to bake cookies with my mom over facetime in july 2025, written by rushia harada. Please consider the information for campaigns that were started in December 2023 of my digital organization system on advertising, and determine the average cpc from mobile devices (round to three decimals).

I'm researching U.S. soccer history and l want to better understand the background of American soccer talent. On the two year anniversary of that date, I want to celebrate. Can you tell me which events I have scheduled on my calendar between 6pm and 4am of the next day?

I want to get the total units sold on june in the year 2022 in our car dealership, then use that number as an ID to search the metropolitan museum of art collection for the artwork with that exact id and provide its official title and the department.

To discuss the matter, what time am I free before calling my parents on july 20, 2025 according to my calendar? Give me the title of the article.
According to my local movie data, have I watched the movie recommended by kcpfan46 in the movie suggestions channel?
